subject: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bauer <t.bauer@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

Tom — following our exec sync, we'd like to establish a short weekly rollcall to keep the joint roadmap (MAP) on track through your evaluation and procurement windows. The meeting would be 30 minutes, cadence: weekly, and intended outcomes are:
- brief status update on evaluation milestones (pass/fail)
- owner-level action item review
- clock check on procurement/DocuSign timeline

Proposed slots (your TZ noted PDT):
1) Mon 10/12 10:00–10:30 PDT
2) Tue 10/13 08:00–08:30 PDT
3) Thu 10/15 15:00–15:30 PDT

Agenda draft attached (NBH-Eval-Plan-v2.xlsx). Please confirm attendees and any timezone constraints. If you prefer a different day/time we can accommodate — the goal is to land a recurring that aligns with your procurement and evaluation owners.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

---
From: Tom Bauer <t.bauer@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

Priya — thanks for the clear plan. We definitely need a weekly touch while the eval runs. A couple notes:
- Primary attendees: me (Tom Bauer), Sarah Lee (PM, evaluation lead) and our legal rep from Contracts (we loop them in when the final SOW/terms are close).
- Timezones: our PM and legal are Eastern time — Mon 10:00 PDT is 13:00 EDT which works for us.
- Procurement note: we expect an internal procurement window around the week of 11/9; that will be the hard deadline for closing.

Please book the Monday slot and put Contracts on the recurring invite as optional for now. Also, Sarah asked if you could include a short section on evaluation acceptance criteria in the agenda (pass/fail checkpoints).

Cheers,
Tom
Tom Bauer
Director, Digital Platforms
NorthBridge Health

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bauer <t.bauer@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

Great — booking Mon 10/12 10:00 PDT as recurring (weekly) for now. Rishi, Marissa: please see Tom's ask to add a short "acceptance criteria" block in the MAP agenda (one slide) and confirm owners for the first three eval checkpoints. Ben, please add Contracts as optional on the invite and include a DocuSign readiness check item in the 11/9 prep slot.

Quick proposed owner assignments (subject to your confirmation):
- Eval criteria doc and test harness: Marissa Cole
- Infra readiness / private deployment checklist: Rishi Malhotra
- Contract coordination / internal procurement prep: Ben Carter

I attached the current eval plan (NBH-Eval-Plan-v2.xlsx) and will circulate a calendar hold.

Thanks — Priya

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-06T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

Priya — confirmed. I'll scope the infra checklist this week and post a short runbook in the shared Drive link (will add to the invite). Two notes:
1) For the private deployment eval we need a list of sample datasets and max sequence lengths to tune batching. Tom/Sarah — can you share a minimal sample (anonymized) we can use?
2) For timeline risk: if procurement slips past 11/9, we should have a fallback plan for a short pilot that can start with hosted endpoints to avoid a hard hit to your go-live date. I'll draft the fallback options and have them ready for the first call.

-Rishi
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-07T15:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

Hi Priya / Ben — tagging as Contracts. We reviewed the eval plan and have two quick redline items on terms: data retention and audit log export cadence. Can Ben share the standard retention SLA language and the audit export frequency? We'll add our suggested edits into DocuSign once aligned.

Thanks,
NorthBridge Contracts Team

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-11T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap: weekly readiness rollcall & timezone triage

All — calendar hold is set for Mondays 10:00–10:30 PDT starting 2026-10-12 (invite attached: calendar-hold-1011.ics). Short meeting notes / action items for the first week:
- Marissa: add 1-slide "acceptance criteria" to the agenda and upload to Drive (due 2026-10-11 EOD) — owner: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
- Rishi: infra checklist + fallback hosted pilot options (draft) — due 2026-10-12 morning — owner: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
- Ben: provide standard data retention SLA text and audit export cadence (to Contracts) — due 2026-10-12 EOD — owner: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
- Tom / Sarah: send anonymized sample dataset for infra tuning — due 2026-10-09 EOD — owner: t.bauer@northbridgehealth.com

Attachments: NBH-Eval-Plan-v2.xlsx (eval checklist + agenda), calendar-hold-1011.ics

If any of the due dates are a problem please flag here — otherwise we'll go with the plan and use the first 10 minutes of the recurring to surface blockers.

Best,
